_note: Sources are official pages verified 2026-09-14 (ec.europa.eu, mfe.gov.ro, identitate.gov.ro, fonduri-ue.gov.ro). `funding-assets.mjs fetch <key>` downloads them, unzips, rasterises .ai/.pdf logos, and prints the candidates matching `pick` (globs, in display order). Nothing becomes a banner until a person confirms (`funding-assets.mjs confirm`). Re-check the manual before first use: rules change.
_rules_common: EU emblem: statement spelled out in full next to the emblem, never the acronym 'UE'; minimum height 1 cm (2 cm bilingual); at least as large (height or width) as the biggest other logo on the page; free space between logos not smaller than the emblem; the set on the front / first page of every deliverable; no contractor logos. Order for RO 2021-2027 programmes: EU → Guvernul României → programme logo.

pocidif.name: PoCIDIF — Programul Creștere Inteligentă, Digitalizare și Instrumente Financiare 2021–2027 (FEDR)
pocidif.rules: MIV PoCIDIF 2026 §2.1–2.2: EU emblem with the full statement (Cofinanțat when FEDR + state budget, Finanțat when FEDR only), Guvernul României, PoCIDIF logo, in this order; EU emblem same size as the others; PoCIDIF logo min 25 mm / 95 px wide; web: set at the top, colour, plus the sentence 'Pentru informații detaliate despre celelalte programe cofinanțate de Uniunea Europeană, vă invităm să vizitați www.mfe.gov.ro'. Not required on internal documents; required on deliverables.

pnrr.name: PNRR — Planul Național de Redresare și Reziliență (NextGenerationEU)
pnrr.rules: MIV PNRR iunie 2024: on every PNRR material — EU logo with the text 'Finanțat de Uniunea Europeană NextGenerationEU' top-left, Guvernul României, PNRR logo top-right (last on the top row); bottom text 'PNRR. Finanțat de Uniunea Europeană – UrmătoareaGenerațieUE'; the programme page https://mfe.gov.ro/pnrr/ and https://www.facebook.com/PNRROficial/ on all materials; slogan 'PNRR: Fonduri pentru România modernă și reformată!'. EU emblem min 1 cm high, at least as large as the other logos.

poc-2014-2020.name: POC / Instrumente Structurale 2014–2020 (FEDR)
poc-2014-2020.text: Proiect cofinanțat din Fondul European de Dezvoltare Regională prin Programul Operațional Competitivitate 2014-2020
poc-2014-2020.rules: MIV Instrumente Structurale 2014–2020 (ian. 2018): mandatory set EU emblem (with the words 'Uniunea Europeană' under it), Guvernul României, [PO logo if it exists], Instrumente Structurale 2014-2020 — in this order, left to right, in the header of the first page; EU emblem at least as large as the biggest other logo; free space between logos at least the emblem size. A separate official POC logo file was not found on mfe.gov.ro — ask the beneficiary for it.
